source: onyx-1 indexer, answers to the worlds job queries, recorded by 7k3 from the sandbox through its proxy (gnomcp shows no raw GraphQL)

answers.query: query($path: String!) { getTransactions(where: { messages: { value: { pkg_path: { eq: $path } } } }) { block_height messages { value { __typename ... on MsgCall { pkg_path caller } } } } }

query($limit: Int!) { getTransactions(where: { messages: { typeUrl: { eq: "exec" } } }, order: { heightAndIndex: ASC }, limit: $limit) { block_height messages { value { __typename ... on MsgCall { pkg_path caller } } } } }
